selected_method_description: Development selected `main_calibrated` with deployment calibration {'duration_penalty': 0.0, 'dose_penalty': 16.0, 'stop_bonus': 0.0}. All five seeds remain retained. The main continuation compares two three-million-interaction settings per seed; each seed's checkpoint/setting is selected on original tuning return. Additional bounded pilots and any self-curriculum restarts are explicitly counted. This is development-selected continuation with more compute, not an equal-compute algorithm comparison. The selected paths and calibration are fully recorded; public calibration is distinguished from gradient learning.

protocol.rule: rank original mean tuning return; promote first candidate passing confirmation point gates; otherwise retain previous efficient PPO
